description: Implementation of the ‘Wari Mahima - Ape Urumaya’ National Programme
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-05-11 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Small-scale irrigation projects and Ellanga systems of Sri Lanka which have been historically evolved remain as community centered water management systems that have contributed to the sustainable maintenance of rural agriculture and national food security. However, it has become necessary to make special focus on these systems due to sedimentation, structural weaknesses, low irrigation efficiency, encroachments in preserved zones associated with Ellanga systems and climate changes. Therefore, the ‘Wari Mahima - Ape Urumaya’ National Programme has been planned to be implemented with the aim of enrichment of agricultural prosperity and promotion of the rural economy of agricultural units based on small rural irrigation projects, Ellanga systems and villages. For this purpose, provisions of Rs.1,000 million have been allocated through the budget proposals 2026. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Agriculture, Livestock, Lands and Irrigation to implement the proposed programme, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Provision of an additional compensation for 245 families who have lost their paddy lands due to the construction of the Yan Oya Reservoir in lieu of alternative paddy lands
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-05-11 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Yan Oya Reservoir with the capacity of 169 million cubic meters has been constructed with the objective of providing water for cultivation in both Yala and Maha seasons across approximately 11,500 acres of paddy lands belonging to the Districts of Anuradhapura and Trincomalee. Payment of compensation for the lands acquired in constructing the said reservoir is carried out as per the Government valuation. 313 alternative paddy land plots have been provided for families who have lost paddy lands due to the said project in the Horowpathana Divisional Secretariat Division in the Anuradhapura District. Further, approval has been granted at the Cabinet meeting held on 2024-03-18 to grant additional compensations in lieu of alternative paddy lands for 614 selected families and the Horowpathana Divisional Secretary has identified 540 families eligible to receive additional compensation and provided compensation for them. Another 245 families who are eligible to receive additional compensation have been identified, since it is not possible to provide an alternative paddy land. The value of one and a half (1 ½) acres of paddy lands cultivated in both Yala and Maha Seasons using irrigation water has been identified as Rs.1,800,000/- each by the Chief Government Valuer. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Agriculture, Livestock, Lands and Irrigation to pay an additional compensation of Rs.1,800,000/- for 245 families further identified, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of a ‘Trust’ for maintaining the management of the Jaffna Thiruvalluvar Cultural Centre
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-05-11 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The 11-storey Jaffna Thiruvalluvar Cultural Centre has been constructed with the assistance of the Government of India as a focal point for cultural activities in Sri Lanka and with the aim of expanding bilateral cooperation in promoting, preserving and fostering the cultural heritage of Jaffna. As per the Memorandum of Understanding signed for the management of the Jaffna Thiruvalluvar Cultural Centre as approved at the Cabinet meeting held on 2022-02-21, a Joint Management Committee has been appointed to take decisions regarding the activities of the said Cultural Centre. As per the provisions of the said Memorandum of Understanding, after the completion of the construction of the project, the said Cultural Centre should be handed over to the Jaffna Municipal Council through the Government of Sri Lanka. Following such handover, an agreement has been reached between the relevant parties to establish a Trust to carry out its management activities. Clearance of the Attorney General has been received for the draft Deed of Trust prepared for this purpose. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Buddhasasana, Religious and Cultural Affairs to establish a Trust to continue the management activities of the Jaffna Thiruvalluvar Cultural Centre, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Entering into Memoranda of Understanding between Sri Lanka and the Republic of Belarus
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-05-11 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body:
- The Minister of Foreign Affairs, Foreign Employment and Tourism is scheduled to pay an official visit to the Republic of Belarus from 2026-05-12 to 2026-05-15. Further strengthening the cooperation between the two countries, the Cabinet granted approval to sign the following Agreement and Memoranda of Understanding during the said official visit, covering the fields of aviation, higher education and health

Air Service Agreement between the Government of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka and the Government of the Republic of Belarus.


Memorandum of Understanding on Cooperation in the field of Higher Education between the Ministry of Education, Higher Education and Vocational Education of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka and the Ministry of Education of the Republic of Belarus.


Memorandum of Understanding on Cooperation in the field of Health Care between the Ministry of Health and Mass Media of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka and the Ministry of Health of the Republic of Belarus.

description: Calling for Investment proposals to implement a Mixed Development Project in the plot of land belonging to the Urban Development Authority, located in the heart of the Kottawa town
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-05-11 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - A plot of land in extent of 01 acre 01 rood 19.40 perches situated in the heart of Kottawa town, facing the High Level Road within the limits of the Maharagama Urban Council in the Colombo District, has been transferred to the Urban Development Authority as a free Grant under section 6(1) of the State Lands Ordinance. The Special Committee appointed by the Cabinet to recommend currently unutilized lands owned by the Urban Development Authority for most suitable development activities, has recommended that the said plot of land be used for the implementation of a mixed development project. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Transport, Highways and Urban Development to invite investment proposals in accordance with the Government Procurement Guidelines to dispose of the said land to a suitable investor on a long-term lease basis for a period of 99 years for the implementation of the said project, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Appointment to the Post of Director General of Customs
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-05-04 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The tenure of office of Mr. S.P. Aruggoda, presently serving in the Post of Director General of Customs, is due to expire on 2026-05-05. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Planning and Economic Development to appoint Mr. Wimal S. K. Liyanagama, Special Grade Officer of the Sri Lanka Administrative Service, presently serving as the Director General of the Department of Management Services, to the vacant post of Director General of Customs, with effect from 2026-05-06, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Entering into a Memorandum of Understanding between the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka and the Russian Federation on the Development of Cooperation in the field of Railway Transport
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-05-04 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Ministry of Transport, Highways and Urban Development of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka and the Ministry of Transport of the Russian Federation have agreed to enter into a Memorandum of Understanding on the Development of Cooperation in the of field of Railway Transport. Through the signing of the said Memorandum of Understanding, it is expected to implement joint projects in accordance with the laws and regulations of both countries so as to achieve equal and mutually beneficial outcomes, for the need of the development of railway transport in the country. The proposed Memorandum of Understanding will establish cooperation in the fields of construction, modernization, electrification, digitalization of railway infrastructure and consultancy services and supply chain for railway equipment and spare parts of the railway system of the country. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Transport, Highways and Urban Development to sign the said Memorandum of Understanding, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Signing of Memoranda of Understanding during the State Visit of the President of Viet Nam to Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-05-04 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - On the invitation of Hon. President of Sri Lanka Anura Kumara Dissanayake, Hon. President of the Socialist Republic of Viet Nam is scheduled to visit Sri Lanka from 2026-05-07 and 08. Enhancing the cooperation between the two countries, signing of the following Memoranda of Understanding (MoUs) during the said State Visit, covering several sectors was approved by the Cabinet: Memorandum of Understanding for Cooperation in the field of Information and Communications between the Ministry of Health and Mass Media of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka and the Ministry of Culture, Sports and Tourism of the Socialist Republic of Viet Nam.Memorandum of Understanding on Cultural Cooperation between the Ministry of Buddhasasana, Religious and Cultural Affairs of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka and the Ministry of Culture, Sports and Tourism of the Socialist Republic of Viet Nam.Memorandum of Understanding on the Development in the field of Religion, Welfare of Religious Students, Propagation and Preservation of Religious Beliefs and Customs between the Ministry of Buddhasasana, Religious and Cultural Affairs of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka and the Ministry of Ethnic and Religious Affairs of the Socialist Republic of Viet Nam. Memorandum of Understanding on Cooperation in the Fields of Science and Technology between the Ministry of Science and Technology of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka and the Ministry of Science and Technology of the Socialist Republic of Viet Nam.Memorandum of Understanding on Cooperation in Police Training and Scientific Research between the National Police Academy of Sri Lanka of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka and the People's Police Academy of the Socialist Republic of Viet Nam.

description: Designate of Businesses as a Secondary Business of Strategic Importance
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-05-04 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The following companies have planned to operate 06 businesses under the fields of Information Technology, Logistics, Advisory Services & General business, Infrastructure & Marine Technology in the Colombo Port City. The proposed businesses are expected to bring approximately US$ 14.6 million of foreign direct investments into the country and generate approximately 650 new job opportunities within a period of 05 years. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Planning and Economic Development to designate the following companies as secondary businesses of strategic importance in accordance with the provisions of the Colombo Port City Economic Commission Act No.11 of 2021 and to grant them exemptions or incentives proposed in the Act, was approved by the Cabinet:DIJITAL TEAM LK (PVT) LTDVITALHUB INNOVATIONS LAB (PVT) LTDWELVAART SOLUTIONS (PVT) LTDADVANTIS BRIDGE (PRIVATE) LIMITEDJAVA GLOBAL ACCESS PLATFORM FZ-LLCOCEAN BUILDERS LLC

description: Designation of Businesses as Primary Businesses of Strategic Importance under the Colombo Port City Economic Commission Act
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-05-04 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Prime Melwa Port City (Pvt) Limited and Home Lands Port City (Pvt) Limited have planned to construct an ultra-luxury residential tower and an eco-friendly luxury residential twin tower in the Colombo Port City, investing US$ 127.6 million and US$ 150.0 million respectively. The implementation of these projects will create approximately 1,170 new job opportunities. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. President, in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Planning and Economic Development, to designate Prime Melwa Port City (Pvt) Limited and Home Lands Port City (Pvt) Limited as Primary Businesses of Strategic Importance under the Colombo Port City Economic Commission Act, No. 11 of 2021, and to grant them exemptions or incentives proposed in the Act, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Proposed amendments to the Finance Business Act, No.42 of 2011
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-05-04 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - It has been about 15 years since the Financial Business Act No. 42 of 2011 came into force, and during that time, significant changes have occurred in the domestic and global financial landscape. Therefore, the need to review and strengthen the regulatory framework governing the Finance Companies Sector has arisen. Accordingly, it has been identified that the provisions of the Act, particularly relating to licensing, supervision, resolution, corporate governance, protection of depositors and enforcement against unauthorized deposit-taking, need to be amended. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. President, in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Planning and Economic Development, to instruct the Legal Draftsman to prepare a Bill, enabling to amend the Financial Business Act No. 42 of 2011, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Appointment to act in the Post of Director General of Commerce
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-05-04 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Due to the retirement of Mrs. Ameina Shafi, who served in the Post of Director General of Commerce, from the Public Service with effect from 2026-04- 09 upon the completion of 60 years of age, the said Post has fallen vacant by now.  Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minster of Trade, Commerce, Food Security and Co-operative Development to appoint Mr. M.S. Mahadiulwewa, a Grade I Officer of the Senior Executive Service Category of the said Department, presently serving as the most Senior Director of Commerce of the Department of Commerce, to act in the Post of Director General of Commerce with immediate effect, in addition to the duties of his substantive post, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amending the Consumer Affairs Authority Act, No.9 of 2003
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-05-04 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Cabinet has granted approval on several previous occasions to amend the Consumer Affairs Authority Act, No. 9 of 2003. The Legal Draftsman is currently preparing the relevant amending Bill as per the approval given at the Cabinet meeting held on 2023-05-02, and the Legal Draftsman has informed that it is appropriate to obtain the policy approval of the present Cabinet for the purpose. Accordingly, taking into account the need to restructure the Consumer Affairs Authority as well, the proposal made by the Minister of Trade, Commerce, Food Security and Cooperative Development to instruct the Legal Draftsman to expeditiously complete the preparation of the relevant Bill, enabling to amend the Consumer Affairs Authority Act, No. 9 of 2003, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Implementation of Phase II of the Ruwanwella Water Supply Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-05-04 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Ruwanwella Water Supply Project has been designed to meet the water needs of about 36,000 people residing in the Ruwanwella, Bulathkohupitiya and Yatiyanthota Divisional Secretariat Divisions. The project is implemented in two phases, and the contract for Phase I has already been awarded. Phase II of the project includes the contract packages such as construction of 03 ground reservoirs, construction of 02 booster pump stations and laying of transmission and distribution lines including associated electro-mechanical installations. In order to select a contractor for the purpose, bids have been invited following the National Competitive Bidding Procedure, and seven (07) bids have been received. Following the evaluation of the bids, based on the recommendations submitted by the Standing High Level Procurement Committee and the Procurement Appeal Board, the proposal made by the Minister of Housing, Construction and Water Supply to award the said contract to the responsive lowest bidder, M/s DIMO - CRCC 25 Joint Venture, for a sum of Rs.869.08 million (excluding tax), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Implementation of the Climate Resilient Sustainable Water Supply and Sanitation Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-05-04 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Climate Resilient Sustainable Water Supply and Sanitation Project is proposed to be implemented under the funds of the Asian Development Bank. The project is expected to achieve the objectives such as improving access to reliable and sustainable water supply and sanitation services, strengthening the climate resilience of water sector infrastructure, and reducing non-revenue water in several areas of the Western Province of Sri Lanka. The total estimated cost of the project is US$ 250 million out of which US$ 200 million is expected to be financed through the ordinary capital resources of the Asian Development Bank. The following sub-projects are planned to be implemented under the said project:Ambatale Water Treatment System Improvement ProjectJubilee Water Supply System Improvement ProjectKolonnawa Non-Revenue Water Management ProjectLunugamvehera Integrated Water Scheme with a capacity of 20,000m3Jaffna Waste Water ProjectAccordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Housing, Construction and Water Supply to implement the said project under the funds of the Asian Development Bank and to expeditiously initiate the procurement activities relating to the 05 sub-projects, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Purchase of vehicles required for the island-wide Range Offices and Beat Offices under the Department of Wildlife Conservation

description: Obtaining Transaction Advisory Services from the Asian Development Bank for the development of the 150MW Kondachchi Wind Power Plant
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-05-04 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Kondachchi Wind Power Project has been identified as a priority project to be developed under a Novel Project Implementation Model as a part of the Government’s strategic vision to expand renewable energy capacity and promote private sector participation. The proposed project, which consists of a 150 MW wind power plant integrated with a state-of-the-art Battery Energy Storage System, will also allow to operate as a Virtual Firm Energy Plant. Under the concurrence granted by the Asian Development Bank (ADB) to provide transaction advisory services to support the development of renewable energy projects by calling competitive bidding, the appropriateness of utilizing the expertise of the said Bank to structure the Kondachchi Wind Power Project has been identified. Under the said transaction advisory service, the ADB will act as a transaction advisor throughout the project development cycle, from the preparation of bidding documents to tendering and award. Also, the estimated cost of US$ 1.2 million for the transaction advisory services is proposed to be provided as a Grant financed under the ADB’s Technical Assistance Framework. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Energy for the National System Operator, the successor entity of the Ceylon Electricity Board, to obtain transaction advisory services from the ADB for the Kondachchi Wind Power Project, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Awarding the Consultancy Service Contract for Power System Strengthening and Renewable Energy Integration Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-05-04 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Cabinet, at its meeting held on 2025-03-17, granted approval for the implementation of the procurement process to select a consultancy service agency for the Power System Strengthening and Renewable Energy Integration Project implemented under the Asian Development Bank funds. Accordingly, Expressions of Interest were invited and 11 companies have submitted their Expressions of Interest. A Request for Proposals has been issued to the shortlisted companies from among the said companies in accordance with the guidelines of the Asian Development Bank. 04 companies have submitted their proposals for the same. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Energy to award the said Consultancy Service Contract to Mercados Aries International S.A. of Spain for a sum of US$ 1.49 million + Sri Lankan Rupees 43.20 million (excluding VAT) was approved by the Cabinet, based on the recommendations submitted by the Cabinet Appointed Consultants Procurement Committee after evaluating the said proposals.

description: Awarding the Contract for Ground Handling Services of Sri Lankan Airlines at the Sydney Airport in Australia
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-05-04 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Contract for Ground Handling Services of Sri Lankan Airlines at the Sydney Airport, Australia has expired on 2026-04-30. Therefore, bids have been invited under the limited International Competitive Procurement Procedure to select a contractor for supplying the said service. 03 bids have been received for the same. The proposal made by the Minister of Ports and Civil Aviation to award the said Contract to Menzies Aviation (Australia) Pty Ltd., the substantially responsive lowest bidder for a sum of AUD 8.32 million based on the recommendation submitted by the Standing High Level Procurement Committee after evaluating the said bids, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Awarding the Contract for the improvement of a road section between Thalalla and Kudawella of the Colombo-Galle-Hambatota-Wellawaya Road (A002)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-05-04 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Bids have been invited under the National Competitive Procurement Procedure to rehabilitate and improve a road section of 12.33km (from 172+705 to 185+040) between Thalalla and Kudawella of the Colombo-Galle-Hambatota-Wellawaya Road (A002) under the Widening and Improvement Programme for National Highways. 07 bids have been received for the same. The proposal made by the Minister of Transport, Highways and Urban Development to award the said Contract to M/s Rathna – Suhada Joint Venture Civic Engineers & Contractors (Pvt) Ltd, the substantially responsive lowest bidder for a sum of Rs. 818.23 million (excluding VAT), based on the recommendation submitted by the High Level Procurement Committee after evaluating the said bids, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Awarding the Contract for the improvement of a road section between Kamburugamuwa to Devinuwara of the Colombo-Galle-Hambatota-Wellawaya Road (A002)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-05-04 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Bids have been invited under the National Competitive Procurement Procedure to rehabilitate and improve a road section of 13.3km (from 154+000 to 167+300) between Kamburugamuwa to Devinuwara of the Colombo-Galle-Hambatota-Wellawaya Road (A002) under the Widening and Improvement Programme for National Highways. 04 bids have been received for the same. The proposal made by the Minister of Transport, Highways and Urban Development to award the said Contract to M/s RR Construction (Pvt) Ltd, the substantially responsive lowest bidder for a sum of Rs. 1,207.74 million (excluding VAT), based on the recommendation submitted by the High Level Procurement Committee after evaluating the said bids, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Acquisition of lands required from Maradana to Avissawella for the future development activities of the Kelani Valley Railway Line
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-05-04 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The policy approval of the Cabinet has previously been granted to develop the Kelani Valley Railway Line from Maradana to Avissawella, to acquire the lands required for the same and to carry out resettlement activities. Further, prior approval of the Cabinet has also been granted to allocate necessary provisions for resettlement of families living in railway right-of-way along the said railway line. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Transport, Highways and Urban Development to acquire through the relevant Divisional Secretaries, essential lands located from Maradana to Awissawella in the Divisional Secretariat Divisions of Colombo, Thimbirigasyaya, Sri Jayewardenepura Kotte, Maharagama, Homagama, Padukka and Seethawaka relating to the development of the Kelani Valley Railway Line, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Procurement of 20,000 Metric Tons of Urea (Prilled) required for paddy and other crops during the year 2026
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-05-04 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The State Fertilizer Company Limited has planned to procure 20,000 metric tons of urea in the form of straight fertilizer and for the formulation of mixed fertilizer required for vegetable and other crop cultivation, enabling to prepare the required stock of urea fertilizer for the 2026/2027 Maha Season. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Agriculture, Livestock, Lands and Irrigation to implement the procurement process for the purchase of 20,000 metric tons of urea (Prilled) following the International Competitive Procurement Procedure, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Endorsement of the Global Charter on Children’s Care Reforms
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-05-04 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Sri Lanka is a long-standing State Party to the United Nations Convention on the Rights of the Child and is committed to fulfilling its international obligations to protect and promote the rights of the children. The ‘Global Charter on Children’s Care Reforms’ has been developed as a multilateral initiative grounded in the principles of the United Nations Convention on the Rights of the Child. The Charter calls upon Governments to take steps to support families and prevent unnecessary separation of children from their families, to prioritize safe and nurturing family-based alternative care when separation occurs, and to progressively reduce the provision of institutional care for children. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Women and Child Affairs for Sri Lanka to endorse the Global Charter on Children’s Care Reforms, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Allocation of Plots of Land from Regional Industrial Estates for Investors to set up Industries
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-05-04 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Regional Industrial Estate Development Programme is a major programme implemented with the aim of promoting industries at the regional level. The selection of investors for the same is done after a full evaluation of the relevant project proposals by the 'Regional Industrial Services Committee' established under the provisions of the Industrial Promotion Act No. 46 of 1990 and the 'Ministerial Project Evaluation Committee' appointed by the Secretary to the Ministry of Industry and Entrepreneurship Development. Accordingly, the said Committees have studied 16 project proposals received and have recommended the allocation of plots of land from 09 Regional Industrial Estates for the implementation of those projects. The proposal made by the Minister of Industry and Entrepreneurship Development to allocate the proposed plots of land to the relevant investors on long-term lease basis of 35 years as per the said recommendations, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: National Export Development Plan (2026 – 2030) for Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-05-04 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Budget 2025 proposed the preparation of a National Export Development Plan as a national priority for enhancing export competitiveness and achieving sustainable export-led economic growth. Accordingly, the Sri Lanka Export Development Board, in collaboration with public and private sector stakeholders involved in the export sector, with technical assistance under the Policy-Based Loan Programme of the Asian Development Bank, has prepared the National Export Development Plan 2026-2030. The said Plan provides a broad strategic framework to guide and monitor Sri Lanka's export development process, with the target of earning US$ 36 billion in foreign exchange from exports of goods and services by the year 2030. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Industry and Entrepreneurship Development to recognize the 'Sri Lanka National Export Development Plan 2026-2030' as the official strategic framework for the development and promotion of exports in Sri Lanka, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Implementation of the Digital Transformation Project of the University of Kelaniya
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-05-04 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Although actions have already been taken to develop basic infrastructure and basic information systems relating to information technology of the University of Kelaniya, it has been recognized that it is inadequate to meet the current needs of the higher education sector in the world rapidly evolving into a digital-centric and dynamic environment. Therefore, a project has been planned to be implemented to digitize all the main learning and management processes of the University of Kelaniya, which currently has 16,368 undergraduate students, 1,114 postgraduate students and 56,619 external degree students registered, as well as about 1,700 academic and non-academic staff, within 02 years and to develop the necessary infrastructure for the same. It is expected to achieve benefits such as improving service delivery, attracting a wide range of students and securing financial sustainability by modernizing systems and operations of the University under the said project. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. Prime Minister, in her capacity as the Minister of Education, Higher Education and Vocational Education, to implement the Digital Transformation Project of the University of Kelaniya, which has been identified under the Public Investment Plan, during the years 2026-2027 at an estimated cost of Rs. 476 million, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Submission of the Publication on Financial Statements and Operations of the Central Bank of Sri Lanka for the year 2025 to Parliament
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-04-27 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - In accordance with the provisions of the Central Bank of Sri Lanka Act, No.16 of 2023, the Central Bank of Sri Lanka shall submit the Financial Statements audited by the Auditor General and approved by the Board of Governors to the Minister in charge of the subject of Finance within 04 months of the end of the financial year concerned, and the Minister in charge of the subject of Finance shall submit the said Report to Parliament within 14 days of receipt. The Publication on Financial Statements and Operations of the Central Bank of Sri Lanka for the year 2025 has been submitted to the Minister of Finance, Planning and Economic Development by the Governor of the Central Bank of Sri Lanka. The said Publication contains an overview of the Central Bank’s institutional performance during the year 2025. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Planning and Economic Development to submit the Publication on Financial Statements and Operations of the Central Bank of Sri Lanka for the year 2025 to Parliament, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Submission of Rules on the Collection of Statistics and Information by the Central Bank of Sri Lanka No.01 of 2026
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-04-27 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Central Bank of Sri Lanka collects statistics and information from external parties to perform its statutory duties and core functions. Provisions have been made available under the Central Bank of Sri Lanka Act, No.16 of 2023 to prescribe the information so collected and the format in which such information is to be provided to the Central Bank of Sri Lanka, the persons subject to reporting requirements, the applicable confidentiality regime and the administrative measures that may be imposed in case of breach of such requirements. Accordingly, the Rules on the Collection of Statistics and Information by the Central Bank of Sri Lanka No. 01 of 2026 has been published in the Gazette Extraordinary Notification No.2479/54 dated 2026-03-12 under the said provisions. The proposal made by the Hon. President, in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Planning and Economic Development, to submit the said Rules to Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Granting permanent appointments to the employees recruited on temporary, casual (on daily wages), substitute, contract or relief basis for Government institutions
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-04-27 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Taking into Consideration that approximately 9,800 employees recruited on temporary, casual (on daily wages), substitute, contract or relief basis are employed in the Public Service, Provincial Public Service, State Corporations, Statutory Boards and Institutions, the Hon. President proposed to grant permanent appointments to them through the budget proposal No. 33.11 for the year 2026. Accordingly, the joint proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Planning and Economic Development and the Minister of Public Administration, Provincial Councils and Local Government to issue the Circular containing the relevant provisions for granting permanent appointments to those employees, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Project for the construction of Interim Housing for families displaced due to the disasters caused by the Cyclone Ditwah and currently residing in safety centres, tents and houses of relatives
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-04-27 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - 6,088 houses were completely damaged and 115,179 houses partially damaged due to the impact of the Cyclone Ditwah. Of these families, 494 families are staying in 20 safety centres in 04 Districts of the Country as of 2026-04-22, while a number of other families are staying in tents and houses of relatives. Further, although actions have been taken to provide a monthly rental allowance of Rs.25,000/- to families who have lost their homes due to landslides and floods and have no place to settle until a new house is built, it has been observed that obtaining houses for rent in those areas has become a problem. Accordingly, the proposal made by the President in his capacity as the Minister of Defence to implement a project to construct interim housing for 1,000 families residing in safety centres, tents and relatives’ houses in the Districts of Kegalle, Kandy, Nuwara Eliya and Badulla due to the damage to their houses by the disasters caused by the Cyclone Ditwah, utilizing the labour contribution of the Sri Lanka Army and in accordance with the housing plan submitted by the National Building Research Organization, until permanent houses are built for them, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Appointment to the Post of District Secretary/Government Agent of the Administrative District of Kegalle
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-04-27 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Since Mr. H.M.J.M. Herath who served as the District Secretary/Government Agent of the Administrative District of Kegalle has been appointed to the Post of Commissioner General for Registration of Persons with effect from 2026-04-10, the Post of District Secretary/Government Agent of the Administrative District of Kegalle has fallen vacant at present. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Public Administration, Provincial Councils and Local Government to appoint Mr. K.G.S. Nishantha, Special Grade Officer of the Sri Lanka Administrative Service, presently serving in the Post of District Secretary/Government Agent of the Administrative District of Ratnapura, to the said vacant Post with immediate effect, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Programme for the re-construction of religious places affected by the Ditwah Cyclone
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-04-27 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Ministry of Buddhasasana, Religious and Cultural Affairs and the Departments in charge of religious affairs coming under its purview have planned a joint programme to provide relief for the reconstruction or repair of all religious places affected due to the Cyclone Ditwah to restore their activities to normalcy. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Buddhasasana, Religious and Cultural Affairs to provide relief as follows for the reconstruction of the said religious places, was approved by the Cabinet:To provide a maximum of Rs. 7.5 million for the construction activities of the sacred places that have been completely destroyed but are suitable for reconstruction at the same location, giving priority to the priests' residence (Avasa Ge), sermon hall, main kovil, church, sanitary facilities, water and electricity.To provide up to a maximum of Rs.5 million for the reconstruction of the sacred places that have been partially damaged.Restoration of sacred places that have sustained minor damages.

description: Procurement for the supply of 6,000 syringes of Adalimumab Injection 40mg in 0.8ml pre-filled syringes
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-04-27 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - International competitive bids have been invited for the purchase of 6,000 syringes of Adalimumab vaccine, which is used to treat a variety of chronic inflammatory and autoimmune diseases in adults and children. Four (04) bids have been received for the same. Based on the recommendation of the Standing High-Level Procurement Committee, the proposal made by the Minister of Health and Mass Media to award the said procurement, to Reliance Life Sciences Pvt Ltd.,India (Manufacturer - Reliance Life Sciences Pvt Ltd., India), the substantially responsive lowest bidder, for a total cost and freight charges of US $ 225,000, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of a Digital Unit under the Independent Television Network
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-04-27 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - In order to strengthen the Independent Television Network in a manner that it can successfully face the future conforming to the institutional objectives of national communication, digital transformation, innovation and providing accurate information to the public, it has been identified that it is appropriate to establish an official digital unit dedicated to digital activities within the organizational structure of the Independent Television Network, assigned with specific responsibilities and human and physical resources. Through this, the Independent Television Network will be availed with many opportunities such as formal management of digital content, dissemination of digital news, maintenance of subscriber relationships, and data analysis. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Health and Mass Media to establish the proposed digital unit as a Strategic Unit, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Taking over of the Base Hospital, Dambulla under the line Ministry of Health and Mass Media for development and upgrading
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-04-27 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Dambulla Base Hospital, an 'A' grade hospital which is administered under the Central Provincial Council, serves a population of about 230,000 people, mainly in the Districts of Matale, Anuradhapura, Polonnaruwa and Kurunegala. The hospital provides primary care services as well as major specialist medical services and has a bed capacity of 354. In order to ensure adequate space and improved infrastructure to meet the demand for health services of the public with a high standard and to use the land on which the hospital is located can be used for economic development purposes in accordance with the Greater Dambulla Development Plan 2022-2032, it has been proposed to relocate the hospital in another location. For the purpose, a plot of land of about 05 acres has been acquired. The cost of relocating the hospital is estimated to be around Rs.7 billion, and since the Central Provincial Council is unable to bear the cost, the Governor of the Central Province has given his consent to take over the hospital to the Central Government and develop the same. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Health and Mass Media to take over the Dambulla Base Hospital under the Ministry of Health and Mass Media, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Calling for Investment Proposals for the disposal of a plot of Land at Maradana Road, Colombo 10, belonging to the Urban Development Authority, on 50 years lease basis
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-04-27 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - A Special Committee has been appointed at the Cabinet meeting held on 2025-04-28 to submit proposals to recommend most suitable development activities for lands belonging to the Urban Development Authority that have not been used for development activities. The said Committee has recommended to call for investment proposals to implement a mixed development project based on new information technology–related products at a plot of land in extent of 01 acre, 01 rood, 12.4 perches located at Maradana Road, Colombo 10 owned by the Urban Development Authority. Accordingly, taking into account a proposal made by the Minister of Transport, Highways and Urban Development, the Cabinet granted approval to call for investment proposals from investors interested in developing the said plot of land as a centre for Sri Lankan technologists for the production of intellectual technological products and services targeting the local market.

description: Preparation of Terms of Reference for Developing and Implementing a Policy and Framework on Micro-Credentials in Sri Lanka in collaboration with the Commonwealth of Learning
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-04-27 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Micro-Credentials are an internationally recognized and effective mechanism for lifelong learning, workforce up skilling and promoting employability in response to rapid technological change and evolving labour market demands. Accordingly, the need to establish a National Policy on Micro-Credentials and a Credit Transfer Framework has been identified to strengthen the higher education and technical and vocational education and training systems and to enhance the international comparability and recognition of Sri Lankan educational qualifications. Accordingly, it has been proposed to hold a workshop in Colombo in May 2026 to prepare Terms of Reference for the said task in collaboration with the Commonwealth of Learning. Accordingly, the Cabinet approved the proposal made by the Hon. Prime Minister, in her capacity as the Minister of Education, Higher Education and Vocational Education, to sign an agreement between the Commonwealth Learning and the Ministry of Education, Higher Education and Vocational Education of Sri Lanka to formulate and implement a National Policy and Framework on Micro-Credentials for Sri Lanka, with the cooperation and full financial contribution of the Commonwealth Learning.

description: Signing of Memoranda of Understanding during the State Visit of His Excellency Dr. Mohamed Muizzu, President of the Republic of Maldives to Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-04-27 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - On the invitation of Hon. President Anura Kumara Dissanayake, His Excellency     Dr. Mohamed Muizzu, the President of the Republic of Maldives is scheduled to visit Sri Lanka from 2026-05-03 to 2026-05-05. Enhancing the cooperation between the two countries, signing of the following Memoranda of Understanding (MoUs) during the said State Visit, covering several sectors was approved by the Cabinet:Memorandum of Understanding between the Ministry of Defence and National Service of the Republic of Maldives and the General Sir John Kotelawala Defence University of Sri Lanka relating to organizing training programmes, implementing staff exchange programmes and conducting joint research activities.Memorandum of Understanding between the Ministry of Education, Higher Education and Skills Development of the Maldives and the Ministry of Education, Higher Education and Vocational Education of Sri Lanka on cooperation in the field of Teachers and School Leaders Training and Professional Development.Memorandum of Understanding between the Ministry of Health, Family, and Welfare of the Republic of Maldives and the University of Colombo of Sri Lanka on Academic Cooperation.Memorandum of Understanding between the Republic of Maldives and the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka on Co-operation in the Field of Tourism.Memorandum of Understanding between the National Archives of Maldives and the Department of National Archives of Sri Lanka on Archiving Cooperation.Memorandum of Understanding between the Ministry of Youth Empowerment, and Fitness of the Republic of Maldives and the Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports of Sri Lanka on Sports and Youth Development.

description: Establishment of and Staff Recruitment for Short-Term Treatment and Rehabilitation Centres under “A Nation United” Anti-Drug Programme
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-04-20 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Due to the increase in the number of people voluntarily seeking treatment services with the recent implementation of the “A Nation United” Anti-Drug Programme, it has been identified that the existing residential facilities are not adequate to meet the increasing demand for treatment services resulting an urgent need to expand structured treatment and rehabilitation services throughout the country. As a remedy to the same, 06 underutilized Government buildings have been identified as suitable for conversion into Short-Term Treatment and Rehabilitation Centres for people voluntarily entering for treatment, and steps are being taken to publish these Centres through a Government Gazette. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Public Security and Parliamentary Affairs to establish the proposed 06 Short-Term Treatment and Rehabilitation Centres and to recruit the necessary staff for the same, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Appointment to the Post of Controller General of Immigration and Emigration
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-04-20 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Approval has been granted at the Cabinet meeting held on 2025-05-19 for the appointment of Mr. Iraj Chaminda Pathiraja, Special Grade Officer of the Sri Lanka Administrative Service, to act full time in the Post of Controller General of Immigration and Emigration. The proposal made by the Minister of Public Security and Parliamentary Affairs to appoint him to the post of Controller General of Immigration and Emigration on permanent basis, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Formulation of an Act for the establishment of the Industrial Transformation and Innovation Authority of Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-04-20 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Officials' Committee appointed under the Chairmanship of the Secretary to the Prime Minister to review the State-Owned Non-Commercial Entities has recommended establishing a single entity by consolidating the Industrial Development Board, the National Enterprise Development Authority and the Small Enterprise Development Division. Based on the said recommendations, policy approval of the Cabinet has been granted at the Cabinet meeting held on 2025-12-29 to establish the Industry Transformation and Innovation Authority of Sri Lanka. Accordingly, the Ministry of Industries and Entrepreneurship Development has prepared a draft legal framework in consultation with all relevant parties and with the technical assistance of the Asian Development Bank. The proposal made by the Minister of Industries and Entrepreneurship Development to instruct the Legal Draftsman to draft a new Bill based on the said draft, to establish the Industry Transformation and Innovation Authority of Sri Lanka', was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Submission of Imports and Exports (Control) Regulations No.01 of 2026, issued under the Imports and Exports (Control) Act, No.1 of 1969 for approval of Parliament
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-04-20 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Importation of retreaded tyres, including those used for aircraft, has been prohibited by the Special Import License Regulations No. 01 of 2023, published through the Gazette Extraordinary Notification No. 2312/77 and dated 2023-01-01. However, the Ministry of Ports and Civil Aviation has requested for an exemption for the importation of retreaded aircraft tyres classified under HS code 4012.13 for SriLankan Airlines. Taking into account essential operational and safety requirements, it has been decided to permit the importation of retreaded aircraft tires classified under HS Code 4012.13 and complying with the requirements specified by internationally accredited aviation authorities by Air Carriers of Sri Lanka providing international air services, under a duly executed Supply Agreement between the Air Carrier and the Certified International Provider, subject to the recommendation of the Ministry of Ports and Civil Aviation. Accordingly, the Cabinet approved the proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Planning and Economic Development to submit the Imports and Exports (Control) Regulations No. 01 of 2026, published through the Gazette Extraordinary Notification No. 2481/02 dated 2026-03-23, for approval of Parliament, in accordance with the provisions of the Imports and Exports (Control) Act No.1 of 1969.

description: Procurement for the supply of 800,000 bags with medicines used for dialysis of kidney patients
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-04-20 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Peritoneal dialysis solutions are used for dialysis of patients with chronic renal failure. International competitive bids have been invited for the procurement of the said items, and two (02) bids have been received for the same. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Health and Mass Media to award the procurement for the supply of 800,000 nos. of peritoneal dialysis solution 2 liter bag with integrated asymmetric Y set with blue clamp containing 1.5% Dextrose and Calcium Density 1.25 mmol/L (2.5mEq/L), to Infuxion Lanka (Private) Limited., (Manufacturer: Peritone Health SDN BHD, Malaysia), substantially responsive lowest bidder, based on the recommendation of the Standing High Level Procurement Committee, at a unit price of Rs. 1,112/- and a total delivery price to the Medical Supplies Division of Rs. 889.6 million, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Awarding Contracts for Ground Handling Services of SriLankan Airlines at the Dubai Airport in the United Arab Emirates
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-04-20 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body:
- SriLankan Airlines Limited currently operates scheduled passenger and cargo flights to the Dubai Airport. The Standard Ground Handling Services Agreement signed between SriLankan Airlines and Dnata, the sole provider of ground handling services at the Dubai Airport, for the provision of passenger and ramp handling services, has expired on 2026.03.31. The Standard Ground Handling Services Agreement signed between SriLankan Airlines and Dnata for the supply of cargo warehouse handling services is scheduled to expire on 2026.06.30. The Cabinet approved the proposal made by the Minister of Ports and Civil Aviation to award the relevant contracts as follows, based on the recommendations of the Bid Evaluation Committee and the Standing High-Level Procurement Committee:

*	To award the contract for the Passenger and Ramp Handling Services of SriLankan Airlines Limited at the Dubai Airport for an estimated cost of AED 33.04 million, for a period of 03 years (from 2026-04-01 to 2029-03-31), to Dnata.

* 	To award the contract for the Cargo and Warehouse Services of SriLankan Airlines Limited at the Dubai Airport to an estimated cost of AED 7.6 million, for a period of 03 years (from 2026.07.01 to 2029.06.30), to Dnata.

description: Obtaining Consultancy Services for conducting a feasibility study and preparing detailed plans for the extension of the Kelani Valley Railway Line beyond Avissawella up to Ratnapura
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-04-20 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Approval has been granted at the Cabinet meeting held on 2025.10.21 for conducting a feasibility study and preparing detailed plans for the extension of the Kelani Valley Railway Line beyond Avissawella up to Ratnapura. Calling for Expressions of Interest for the purpose has been made under the National Competitive Bidding Procedure and eight (08) bidders have submitted interests thereon.  After evaluating the technical proposals submitted by the shortlisted bidders, financial proposals of 04 qualified firms have been opened. After evaluating the said financial proposals, the Consultants Procurement Committee has recommended to award the consultancy service contract for conducting a feasibility study and preparing detailed plans for the extension of the Kelani Valley Railway Line beyond Avissawella up to Ratnapura, to   M/s. Resources Development Consultants (Pvt) Ltd for a total sum of Rs.356.22 million (excluding Taxes). Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Transport, Highways and Urban Development to award the relevant procurement as per the said recommendation, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of Zonal Activity Based Learning Centres for Commerce Education
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-04-20 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The importance of establishing Activity Based Commerce Education at the zonal level has been identified for quality development in commerce education with a view to achieving multiple objectives such as teacher development, utilization of such centres as hubs for new technology and resource sharing, enhancement of vocational and further education opportunities, effective utilization of limited physical and human resources, integration of new technology with subject knowledge, sharing of limited resources to ensure equal educational opportunities, and development of competencies in accordance with regional capacity. Accordingly, the project to establish 100 Activity Based Learning Centers to enhance commercial education has been included in the Public Investment Plan as a major investment project for general education from 2026 to 2028 at a total estimated cost of Rs.289 million. As such, the Cabinet granted its approval to commence and implement 25 Zonal Centers covering all 25 Districts across the Country by 2026 as a pilot project under the initial phase of the project, and to establish and operate the remaining Zonal Centres based on the progress of the pilot project, taking into account the proposal made by the Hon. Prime Minister in her capacity as the Minister of Education, Higher Education and Vocational Education.
